name: Mom and Dad's Icehouse
tagline: Cold beer, pool and darts on Third Street in Lexington.
about: Mom and Dad's Icehouse at 529 Third St in Lexington is a friendly bar with a long list of local and regional beers.
Play pool or darts, pick songs on the digital jukebox, or sit outside in back. It has hosted the start of the Lexington Turkey Trot.
conflicts: Hours differ between listings, so the page leaves them off.
